    round_targets = case['round_targets']
    forced = case['forced']
    n = len(round_scores[0])
    candidates = list(range(n))
    history = []

        target = round_targets[i]

                selected.add(idx)
        remaining = [idx for idx in candidates if idx not in selected]
        remaining.sort(key=lambda idx: scores[idx], reverse=True)
        need = target - len(selected)
        if need > 0:
            selected.update(remaining[:need])
        hist_i = sorted(selected, key=lambda idx: scores[idx], reverse=True)
        history.append(hist_i)
        candidates = list(selected)
    retained = candidates
    return {'history': history, 'retained_indices': retained}"}
